en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from Abi `Abdillah Muhammad b. Khalid al-Barqi from Dawud b. Abi Yazid from Abi’l Jarud, Ibn Bukayr, and Burayd b. Mu`awiya al-`Ijli from Abi Ja`far al-Baqir (as). He said:

Al-Husayn (as) was killed while he had three hundred and twenty-something wounds from spears, sword slashes, and arrows. It is reported that these were all on his front side because he (as) did not turn around.
